# Startup Visa Roads

> Startup Visa Roads (visaroads.com) is a product of Ashavid Inc., based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. We are not lawyers or licensed immigration consultants (RCIC). We are exited founders, investment bankers, and grant-committee members who build the business side of a startup visa or entrepreneur immigration case: business plans, financial models, pitch decks, founder mentorship, and a free Express Entry diagnostic tool.

## What we do

- Founder mentorship and startup readiness for startup visa and entrepreneur immigration programs
- Business plan, financial model, and pitch deck preparation
- Free Express Entry CRS diagnostic tool
- Program status guides that link to official government sources

## What we do not do

- We do not provide legal representation or immigration legal advice
- We are not a regulated Canadian immigration consultant (RCIC)
- We do not guarantee visa approval or program outcomes
- We do not process applications on behalf of any government

## Important status note (2026)

Several immigration programs have changed or closed. Always verify current status with the official government source before making decisions. Key changes include:

- Canada Start-Up Visa: check IRCC for current intake status
- Ontario OINP Entrepreneur stream: check Ontario.ca for current status
- Saskatchewan SINP Entrepreneur stream: check Saskatchewan.ca for current status
- Australia BIIP subclass 188: closed; check Home Affairs for current alternatives

- Canada: https://www.canada.ca/ (IRCC)
- USA: https://www.uscis.gov/
- Finland: https://migri.fi/ and https://www.businessfinland.fi/
- Denmark: https://www.nyidanmark.dk/ and https://danishbusinessauthority.dk/
- Estonia: https://startupestonia.ee/
- Netherlands: https://ind.nl/
- Australia: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/
- UAE: https://u.ae/
